title: Single crystal X-ray-structurally characterized Mo(VI) complexes of thiophene-appended amide–imine conjugates for optical recognition of calcon and 2-aminobutyric acid
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,28743-28750
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02104B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sangita Maji, Prasenjit Mandal, Amit Kumar De, Sudeshna Chatterjee, Debasis Das
MoVI) complexes (M1, M2) of thiophene-based amide–imine ligands (L1, L2), experience turn-on fluorescence in DMSO/H2O following ligand displacement protocol, allowing detection of calcon and 2-aminobutyric acid at nanomolar level.
